justifications.type_expressiveness: Good enums for Expr/BinOp/Value and distinguishing EvalError variants, but TypeError carries a free-form String rather than a structured kind/operand-type representation.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enums with the three required EvalError variants and offset on ParseError; library never panics, though TypeError detail is stringly-typed and one `unwrap_or` is undocumented.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Sensible derives, Display/Error impls, and a narrow surface, but no doc comments on any public item and ParseError exposes raw `pub` fields including a String message.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses `?`, `matches!`, derives, and pattern matching cleanly; some non-idiomatic touches remain like an O(n) Vec env lookup and repetitive type-check arms instead of a shared helper.
